objective: Generate every answer for arbitrary new qa_id/clip inputs without reading or inheriting any third-party fixed 682-row answer vector.
prohibited_inputs: any third-party fixed test answer vector
Fresh20 predictions or labels as a selector
public leaderboard scores as a row or hyperparameter selector

validation.split: leave one subject out; all rows sharing a clip path remain together
validation.frozen_cohort: all released training rows and clips; no post-result row selection

owned_system.semantic_base: Self-contained fit/predict implementation using only fold-training option correctness counts, option-set memory, HAU sibling option-text support, multi-answer size priors, and sequence pairwise precedence. It loads no third-party notebook or prediction artifact.
sensor_overlays: HARn/single: use the existing owned skeleton RandomForest OOF whenever the frozen skeleton feature row is numerically present; otherwise retain semantic base.
HAU/emotion: use the prediction only where the independently trained owned ExtraTrees and RandomForest OOF experts agree and the ExtraTrees sensor input is present; otherwise retain semantic base.
owned_system.qwen_visual_channel: Pinned local Qwen3-VL and complete visual manifests are integrity-checked now. Deployment is optional and disabled in core OOF. It may only become a missing-sensor HARn/single fallback after a separately frozen all-missing-sensor cohort passes its own gate.

prediction_grammar.multi: nonempty sorted unique subset of A/B/C/D

counterfactuals.semantic_base_ablation: Disable all sensor overlays; its loss must account for the claimed gain.
counterfactuals.option_permutation: All 24 global A/B/C/D permutations are run through the full 18-fold owned system and inverted to canonical labels; every row must be equivariant.
counterfactuals.invalid: No invalid or missing prediction is permitted.

release_policy.core_gate_pass: Permit a separate network-free test build and two-run byte comparison; do not submit yet.
release_policy.qwen_gate_failure: Keep Qwen diagnostic-only and use semantic-base fallback for missing sensor rows.
release_policy.submission: Only after a complete 682-row candidate passes two network-free dry-runs, manifest verification, quota and finalist-diversity checks.
